Single continuous first-person view at this exact receiving desk. The same clerk gently checks the closed tied bamboo bundle, without opening any pages or adding any item. Only his hands perform that small check. No player face, body, reflection or over-the-shoulder view. No captions, writing, titles, labels, cards, lists, tables, screen text, blur patches, masks, mosaic or overlays. Real paper props must stay unmarked or seen obliquely out of focus through natural photography; do not add postproduction panels.

SPOKEN DIALOGUE WHITELIST IS EMPTY. No dialogue, no narration, no extra human voice, no muttering or reading. Any visible man listens with lips gently closed. Quiet breathing or a natural blink is allowed, but no sustained speaking mouth shapes. No BGM, no background music, no score, no singing or musical rhythm. Only soft location ambience and action-synchronous natural sound.
